expected.note: Operator contact address hard-coded in the User-Agent. Nominatim's usage policy asks each deployment to identify itself, so a reuser must supply their own.

retained.note: Public API endpoints (Nominatim, Overpass mirrors, OSRM, TimeAPI) and Google Maps link templates.
Standard Hermes install path under ~/.hermes/skills, portable across users.
Public landmark addresses, coordinates and a well-known zip code used as examples.

limitations: The one positive is an organization contact rather than personal data; whether it should be replaced or only reviewed is a judgment the reviewer should confirm.
